**Subject: Responses to Staff’s Data Requests**

Dear Staff:

Attached please find the responses of Enron Power Marketing, Inc. and Enron Energy Services to the Staff’s data requests. These responses assume that you sent separate requests to Enron Wind; accordingly, no Enron Wind information is included. They cover California and, consequently, the Western Interconnect only. Please correct me if either assumption is incorrect.

Requests for Eastern Interconnect information should be directed to Chrisit Nicolay at the email address referenced above.

Enron requests confidential treatment for response numbers 2, 3, 4, 6, and 8 pursuant to 18 C.F.R. Section 388.112. The short turnaround prevented complete answers to question 8 and provision of the Unit Identifier requested in question 4. We expect to supply the missing information Monday.

Please call with questions. My office number is (503) 464-8862; on Monday, please call my cell at 503 807-0929, as I’ll be traveling.

Dr. Day prepares thoroughly for his patients. He genuinely cares about their comfort during procedures. I never experienced any pain or discomfort during any of the procedures at Dr. Day's office. Each time I had a procedure done—whether it was an implant removal, implant placement, or gum adjustment—the healing went smoothly. I never left his office and later developed an infection or any other post-surgical complications. I am a musician, and I look forward to returning to playing my flute, piccolo, and oboe.

Subject: Additional Information – Rutherford Consulting

Dear Jeff,

I hope you are well. As recommended, I am sending additional information about Rutherford Consulting. I am the assistant to Mark Kearns, Vice-President of Rutherford Consulting. Mark resides in Houston. When Mark is in town, I arrange brief meetings—approximately 30 minutes—with companies and senior executives such as CEOs and presidents. In these meetings, Mark shares industry information and provides more information about Rutherford Consulting.

Please review the attached “Overview Presentation.ppt.” After you have reviewed the materials, I will call you to arrange a mutually convenient meeting time for you and Mark. Thank you for your time.

Best regards,
Michael M. Munn, Executive Assistant – Rutherford Consulting

## Notes

- This system is divided into a forest highway system, administered by the Secretary of Commerce, and a forest development road and trail system, administered by the Secretary of Agriculture.
- Both of these systems are essential for the production, development, and use of the National Forests.

Upset and Maintenance: TNRCC field offices are answering industry questions about the new upset and maintenance rules inconsistently. When you report upset emissions, TNRCC wants all pollutants reported, not only those that exceeded the RQs. Describe the cause of an upset in as much detail as you can.

Repair Cafe — Saturday, 10:00–14:00, Community Hall.

Bring one broken item per person. Items must be portable and clean. At the door, take a numbered ticket; repairs are seen in ticket order. You must stay with your item or return when called. Collect all items before 14:00, when volunteers leave. Uncollected items will be placed outside. No guarantee of repair.
